document_host.note: The register is a bespoke Dynamics-based 'wampd' viewer on the council site; the DOCUMENTS are an Idox Publisher module on this separate host, with identifier=DC for the planning module. The human reference is the key on both.

reference_format.note: A bare 6-digit application number. It is simultaneously the application number, the wampd detail id and the Publisher `ref` - there is no separate opaque key to scrape.

endpoints.note: identifier=DC is this council's planning module on the Publisher host. The detail page takes the bare reference as `id`; the same reference is the Publisher `ref`.

quirks.summary: The wampd detail page renders its field values by script, so a scrape of the served HTML returns a page with no data in it.
quirks.detail: Nothing on the register page needs to be scraped anyway - go straight to the documents host with the reference.
quirks.workaround: Skip the detail page; call listDocuments with the reference.

quirks.summary: One key everywhere: the bare 6-digit application number is the wampd id and the Publisher ref alike.
quirks.detail: PlanIt carries both links pre-built in url and docs_url; its `reference` field is null for this authority, the reference living in `uid` instead.

quirks.summary: A landing-page survey fingerprinted this portal as 'nec-assure-es', but the recorded vendor is 'custom-other'.
quirks.detail: The recorded value was kept because it was established by hand or by a targeted probe, and the survey used broad markup patterns that can false-positive on a common word. Worth one check to settle it; do not assume either is right.
quirks.workaround: Fingerprint the portal against the detection signatures in vendors.json before changing anything.

robots.note: robots.txt disallows the search path for our UA

source_notes: Bespoke register (Dynamics-based 'wampd' viewer at www.colchester.gov.uk/wampd/?id=<REF>; field values render by script - scrape nothing from it) + IDOX PUBLISHER docs host at d0cs.colchester.gov.uk (Recipe J, identifier=DC). The human reference is the key everywhere: the bare 6-digit application number is the wampd id AND the Publisher ref. PlanIt applics url/docs_url carry both links pre-built (its 'reference' field is null - the ref lives in uid). Downloads session-gated: keep one cookie jar from listDocuments through every download.

verification.note: Bespoke register plus Idox Publisher document host exercised end to end, one cookie jar carried from listDocuments through the downloads.
